messages:
maya (Marketing): Quick sync — proposing Tue 10:00am PT public post for Hyperwave. Need final changelog, canonical docs URL, and a 1-paragraph bench summary + 3 bullets by EOD tomorrow.
aj (Engineering): On it. I'll finish the changelog PR today (PR #8420) and include canary notes + rollback command.
aj (Engineering): changelog draft will include the new prefix-caching behavior and cost delta numbers.
sam (Docs): I'll draft the 'what's new' page and the migration steps. Want AJ's example configs for the snippet.
lina (Product): Webinar confirmed Thu 11am PT. Marketing wants a short bench teaser for the promo: can we get p50 latency and cost/token for common prompts?
aj (Engineering): Bench numbers: p50 down 28% on 8k context, cost/token ~0.013 -> 0.009 after batching+quant. I'll paste a one-paragraph blurb in a sec.
maya (Marketing): Awesome — also need the canonical docs link (not a PR link) so we can surface it in the post and webinar CTAs. Sam, can you pin a stable URL?
sam (Docs): Will publish a stable /docs/hyperwave-release page once PR merges. ETA tomorrow AM.
aj (Engineering): Pasting bench paragraph: "Hyperwave reduces median latency by ~28% on long-context workloads and lowers per-token inference cost by roughly 30% through smarter batching and quant-aware kernels. Customers should see faster responses and simpler migration paths; we include an optional prefix-caching config to keep hot sessions lightning-fast."
maya (Marketing): Nice — can you convert that to 1 para + 3 bullets? we'll use the bullets on the landing and webinar slide.
aj (Engineering): Sure — bullets: 1) ~28% median latency improvement (8k context), 2) ~30% lower per-token cost with batching+quant, 3) optional prefix-caching for steady sub-50ms token p95 on hot sessions.
maya (Marketing): Perfect. Lina — we'll use AJ's paragraph as the teaser and the bullets for the slide. Sam, once /docs/hyperwave-release is live, drop the URL here and I'll put it in the post + webinar registration.
sam (Docs): Will do.
deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: hyperwave-docs -> staging at 2026-03-25T03:00:00Z.
maya (Marketing): Thanks all — I'll lock the post draft tonight and ping for final links. :rocket:
